content: विचिन्त् €10 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To think, consider. .²2 To think of, ponder over, call to mind; विचिन्तयन्ती यमनन्यमानसा <ls>Ś. 4. 1</ls>. .²3 To take into consideration, have regard to, regard; अस्मान् साधु विचिन्त्य संयमधनानुच्चैः कुलं चात्मनः <ls>Ś. 4. 17</ls>. .²4 To intend, fix upon, determine. .²5 To devise, find out, discover. .²6 To imagine. .²7 To perceive, observe (<ab>Ved.</ab>).
